command:
set -u
printf 'VERSION
'; cloudflared --version 2>&1 || true
printf '
USER_CONFIG_FILES
'; find "$HOME/.cloudflared" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f
' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
printf '
SYSTEM_CONFIG_FILES
'; find /etc/cloudflared -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f
' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
printf '
USER_UNITS
'; systemctl --user --no-pager list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -i cloudflared || true
printf '
SYSTEM_UNITS
'; systemctl --no-pager list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -i cloudflared || true
printf '
TUNNELS
'; cloudflared tunnel list 2>&1 | sed -E 's/[0-9a-fA-F-]{30,}/<TUNNEL-ID>/g' | head -30 || true
